title: BridgeRequest
description: CONTRACTS §5.3 request envelope — the single JS→Python call shape. `command` is checked against the §5.2 allow-list by the facade; `payload` is validated against the command-specific schema. Extra top-level fields are forbidden (SECURITY §3). Serialized size is capped at 1 MiB by the facade (§5.4).

command.description: Command name resolved against the §5.2 allow-list.

request_id.description: Client-generated correlation id; echoed back on every response (§5.4).

payload.description: Command-specific arguments; shape enforced by the per-command payload model, free-form here.
